description: List the dental practices newly registered in one state: organization NPIs issued by NPPES in a trailing window of up to 90 days, newest first, with the practice name, specialty, address, phone, official on record, verified website, registry-backed DSO affiliation and the NPI. About a quarter of rows carry existing_dentist_at_building: true, which usually means an existing practice taking a new entity, not a new site. A registration is the day the number was issued, not an opening date. meta.newest_registration says how far the window really reaches (NPPES publishes a week or more behind). Earlier years, by state, are sold as files. Requires a Bearer token on API Pro or Enterprise; without one the newest 30 days are paid per call over HTTP.

days.description: Trailing window in days (default 30, 90 at most).

state.description: Two-letter state code or DC, or the state's name (e.g. TX). Required.

name: get_new_practice_registrations
